Message:
rtnetlink: use for_each_netdev_dump() in rtnl_stats_dump()

Switch rtnl_stats_dump() to use for_each_netdev_dump()
instead of net->dev_index_head[] hash table.

This makes the code much easier to read, and fixes
scalability issues.
